instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: Kiki, Robert, Alice, Katie and Arkin have PE lessons together, and they are currently learning a dance. Kiki and Alice love dancing and have taken dance lessons before. Arkin likes to do gymnastics and is also good at dancing and learning routines. Katie and Robert, however, do not like dancing and are struggling to learn the steps.

atoms.a: From whose point of view is dancing fun?
What might Kiki and Arkin feel before going to their PE lesson?
b: annoyed that they have to learn more dance moves

atoms.a: Who likes to do gymnastics as well?
From whose point of view is dancing not fun?
Why might Katie and Robert like dancing less than the others?
b: they have danced too much and are now tired of it
++they have less experience and aren’t as good yet
